specs.Item Highlight: Auto Keystone & 180° Swivel, All OTT Apps Compatible (Netflix, Prime Jio Hotstar), Wireless WiFi Bluetooth

features: ANDROID 14 SMART OS — ALL YOUR APPS BUILT IN, NO EXTRA STICK: Runs the latest Android 14 with WiFi, so you download and stream all popular OTT and video apps directly from the projector — no external streaming stick, no laptop, no cables. Switch on, connect WiFi, and your home cinema is ready in seconds

NATIVE 1080P FULL HD + 4K SUPPORT ON A 150" GIANT SCREEN: True Native 1920×1080 resolution (not upscaled 720p) with 4K content decoding delivers razor-sharp, vibrant visuals. Scale from a cosy 40 inches up to a massive 150-inch screen — a real theatre experience in your bedroom, living room or hall

AUTO KEYSTONE + 180° SWIVEL — ALIGNED PICTURE, ZERO EFFORT: Smart auto keystone correction squares the image automatically, while the 180° rotatable stand lets you project onto wall or ceiling from any angle. No manual fiddling, no tilted picture — a straight, aligned screen every time

INBUILT 5W SPEAKER + ALL-PORT CONNECTIVITY: Powerful built-in speaker fills the room with clear, loud audio — no soundbar needed. Bluetooth pairs your own speakers or headphones, plus HDMI, USB and WiFi Screen Cast/Miracast mirror your iOS & Android smartphones, laptops, tablets, gaming consoles and streaming devices instantly
BRILLIANT BRIGHTNESS: With 4000 lumens of brightness, our home projector cuts through ambient light, delivering vibrant visuals in any setting, day or night
PORTABLE, LIGHTWEIGHT & VERSATILE: Compact and travel-friendly for movie nights, match screenings, gaming, kids' study, office presentations and outdoor parties
